questions.q: In the WHO oral glucose tolerance test, an adult is given:
questions.why: The standard OGTT uses 75 g of anhydrous glucose; a 2-hour value of 200 mg/dL or more indicates diabetes.

questions.q: Winging of the scapula on pushing against a wall is due to injury of the:
questions.why: The long thoracic nerve (C5–C7) supplies serratus anterior, which holds the scapula against the chest wall.

questions.q: The Declaration of Helsinki (1964) of the World Medical Association deals with:
opts: ethical principles for medical research involving human subjects
the determination of the time of death
questions.why: Helsinki covers research on human subjects; Tokyo (1975) torture, Sydney (1968) death, Geneva (1948) the oath.

questions.q: Ailments from suppressed anger and indignation, along with clean incised wounds, call for:
questions.why: Staphisagria: effects of suppressed anger, humiliation or indignation, and incised wounds, including surgical ones.

questions.q: Marjolin's ulcer is a malignant change in a long-standing scar or chronic ulcer, and is histologically a:
questions.why: Marjolin's ulcer is a slow-growing squamous cell carcinoma arising in burn scars or chronic ulcers.

questions.q: Influenza with drowsiness, dullness, heavy eyelids, trembling and thirstlessness calls for:
The order of evaluation in Kent's method is:
opts: mental generals, physical generals, then particulars
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. From the innermost to the outermost.

questions.q: Profuse, offensive sweat that brings no relief, aggravation at night, and a moist, flabby, indented tongue with intense thirst point to:
questions.why: Mercurius: worse at night and from the heat of the bed, sweats without relief, and has the moist tongue with thirst.

questions.q: Recurrent styes and chalazia on the eyelids, in a sensitive person with suppressed indignation, call for:
questions.why: Staphisagria: styes and chalazia one after another (Boericke), with the background of suppressed anger.

questions.q: Profound melancholy with thoughts of suicide, and bone pains that are worse at night, indicate:
questions.why: Aurum met.: deep depression with a longing to die, and syphilitic bone pains worse at night.
